Title: Bloodhunt and Ritual of the Bitter Rose

Messages.Author: AndrewS
Messages.Body:
I'm not quite sure on the timing of ROTBR at the moment. Does it
occur before or after a bloodhunt is called due to a diablerie? If
after, is it before or after the outcome of that bloodhunt takes
effect?

While I'm asking questions, another one I followed for a while but
have got a bit lost on. Do Telepathic Tracking and Psyche! now occupy
the same timing window? In context, if I control an acting minion,
and at the end of a round with no uncancelled presses, I want to play
Psyche! and my opponent wants to play Telepathic Tracking, who gets to
play?

Cheers,

Andrew.
